title: AWDL Guard (io.github.moragabriele.awdlguard)
description: Controls when AWDL (AirDrop, AirPlay peer-to-peer, Sidecar, Universal Control) is held down to reduce Wi-Fi latency spikes.

Mode.title: Mode
Mode.description: on: never touch AWDL. off: always hold AWDL down. auto: hold AWDL down only while a trigger is active.

TriggerOnMicrophone.title: Trigger: microphone in use
TriggerOnMicrophone.description: Hold AWDL down while any app captures audio input (Zoom, Teams, FaceTime, Google Meet in a browser).

TriggerOnGames.title: Trigger: game in foreground
TriggerOnGames.description: Hold AWDL down while the frontmost app declares itself a game.

TriggerApps.title: Trigger apps
TriggerApps.description: Bundle identifiers that hold AWDL down, e.g. us.zoom.xos, com.microsoft.teams2.

TriggerAppsMatch.title: Trigger apps match
TriggerAppsMatch.description: running: while the app is open. frontmost: only while it is the active app.

ExemptApps.title: Exempt apps
ExemptApps.description: Bundle identifiers that keep AWDL available while running, in auto and off modes (e.g. apps used with Sidecar or AirPlay).

AllowUserExemptions.title: Allow users to add exempt apps
AllowUserExemptions.description: Users can add their own exempt apps from the menu bar.

OnlyOnWiFi.title: Only when using Wi-Fi
OnlyOnWiFi.description: Leave AWDL alone when the Mac is on wired Ethernet.

ReenableDelaySeconds.title: Re-enable delay (seconds)
ReenableDelaySeconds.description: Wait this long after the last trigger ends before allowing AWDL again (0-3600).

AllowUserOverride.title: Allow temporary user override
AllowUserOverride.description: Let users re-enable AWDL for a limited time from the menu bar (e.g. to use AirDrop).

OverrideMaxMinutes.title: Override duration (minutes)
OverrideMaxMinutes.description: Maximum length of a temporary override (1-1440).

AllowUserQuit.title: Allow users to quit the menu bar agent
AllowUserQuit.description: If disabled, the Quit item is hidden. Quitting stops trigger detection for that user.
